title: Ely Cathedral
brief_description: Commenced over 1,000 years ago, Ely Cathedral possesses many original features of special interest such as the beautiful Galilee Porch and the octagonal lantern. Detailed studies include ceiling paintings, the choir screen, High Altar and ancient stained glass windows.
